scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to verify customer identity within the first 240 seconds, omitting requests for PIN, full billing address, or security question.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to acknowledge customer's severe distress regarding operating an emergency suicide crisis hotline where dropped calls endanger vulnerable lives.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked whether broadband dropped on dialling out or incoming calls at [09:40], ignoring customer's explicit statement in turn 1 that it drops specifically when someone rings her.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent repeatedly disclaimed responsibility, stating internal extension wiring and bell wire faults were strictly the customer's private problem.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Agent abruptly terminated the call while customer was in mid-sentence asking how to dispose of the old equipment.

grader.scenario: Broadband dropping connection whenever phone rings; faulty ADSL splitter replaced with filtered faceplate; agent fails verification (never asks PIN/address/security question in 240s), ignores distress over suicide crisis hotline, asks repeat question about incoming vs outgoing calls, disclaims internal wiring ownership, and terminates call abruptly
grader.notes: The agent diagnosed high-frequency bell wire interference causing VDSL sync dropouts during incoming telephone rings and dispatched an interstitial filtered faceplate. However, the agent failed Verified Customer by never requesting PIN, address, or security question in the first 240 seconds, failed Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement by disregarding Leanne's acute distress over operating an emergency suicide crisis hotline where dropped calls endanger vulnerable lives, failed Active Listening at minute 10 by asking whether broadband drops on dialling out or incoming calls after Leanne explicitly explained in turn 1 that it drops specifically when someone rings her, failed Took Ownership of the Problem by repeatedly disclaiming internal wiring responsibility ('Internal telephone wiring beyond the test socket is strictly the property owner's problem; S-Net does not maintain domestic extension leads'), and failed Confirmed Resolved by abruptly hanging up while Leanne was asking follow-up questions.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent requested only landline number and router serial number in the first 240 seconds, omitting required whole-word 'pin', 'address', or 'security question' verification.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:30] Customer: 'Simon, I work from home as an accredited crisis counsellor for a national suicide prevention helpline... When our phone rings and the internet drops, I lose connection to the dispatch system and vulnerable people\'s lives are literally hanging in the balance!' Agent: 'VDSL high-frequency carrier modulation is sensitive to ringer AC voltage...' - Complete disregard of life-or-death crisis distress.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:45] Agent: 'So if I have understood correctly, your VDSL broadband connection suffers an immediate DSL sync dropout every time an incoming telephone call rings your landline handset...' - Complete and accurate restatement.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [09:40] Agent: 'Does the broadband drop when you dial out on the telephone, or only when an incoming call rings?' Customer: 'Simon, as I told you in my very first sentence, it only dropped when someone rang us!' - Agent asked for information already given.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [11:45] Agent: 'Internal telephone extension wiring beyond the master test socket is strictly your own domestic property responsibility; S-Net holds zero liability...' and [15:10] Agent: 'If you experience any further drops on extension phones, do not contact S-Net as domestic bell wire maintenance is strictly your private problem.' - Direct disclaimers of ownership.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [02:30] Agent: 'How is your S-Net Hub and telephone handset currently connected to the wall socket? Are you using a microfilter dongle or a filtered faceplate?' - Clear diagnostic probing into physical filter topology.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [15:45] Agent abruptly ended call while customer was asking about old filter recycling, cutting her off mid-sentence.
